newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Res off peak, downside seen limited.
newsitem.headline: China Res off peak, downside seen limited.

text.p: Shares of China-backed China Resources Enterprise Ltd rose on Tuesday to hit an all time high of HK$8.30 per share before profit-takers emerged.
The shares steadied around HK$8.15 in afternoon trade, up HK$0.35 or 4.49 percent. Volume was 1.87 million shares.
But brokers expected the shares to have a limited downside with support coming from possible spinoff of its property unit.

"Rotational buying for red-chip stocks boosted demand for the shares, particularly as it is backed up by speculation of an exceptional gain from the possible spinoff of its property unit," said a dealing director at a U.S. brokerage.
